title: Web Components Review Quiz
description: Review the small examples from this Web Components course. Take your time and read the reason given for each answer.

questions.question: Why is hello-reader a valid custom tag name?
options: It includes a hyphen
It begins with a capital letter
questions.explanation: A custom element is an HTML tag you define. Its name must contain a hyphen so it does not clash with built-in tags.

questions.question: Can connectedCallback run again for the same element?
options: No, it can only run once forever
Yes, if the element is reconnected
questions.explanation: connectedCallback runs when a custom element joins a document. It may run again if that same element is removed and added later.

questions.question: What does getAttribute("name") return here?
options: The text Mia
The class ReaderName itself
questions.explanation: An attribute is an extra fact written in a tag. A custom element can read it with getAttribute.

questions.question: Which attributes trigger attributeChangedCallback?
options: Every JavaScript variable on the page
The attributes listed in observedAttributes
questions.explanation: observedAttributes names the attributes a custom element watches. attributeChangedCallback runs when one of those values changes.

questions.question: What does attachShadow create?
options: An internal shadow root for the component
A copy of the entire website
questions.explanation: A shadow root is a separate group of page parts inside an element. It helps keep a component's internal structure together.

questions.question: Which paragraph is selected by the shadow style?
options: Every paragraph in the whole document
The paragraph inside the shadow root
questions.explanation: Styles inside a shadow root usually apply to its internal elements. They do not select unrelated elements elsewhere on the page.

questions.question: When is No story yet displayed?
options: When no content is supplied for the slot
Whenever the component has a heading
questions.explanation: A slot is a place where the user of a component can supply content. Default slot text is used when no content is supplied.

questions.question: Where does slot="title" content appear?
options: In every slot at once
In the slot whose name is title
questions.explanation: Named slots let a component accept different pieces of content in different places.

questions.question: Does setting a property always change an HTML attribute too?
options: No, that needs explicit component code
Yes, the browser always copies it
questions.explanation: A property can accept a JavaScript value on an element. A setter runs code when that property is assigned.

questions.question: Where is the book title carried by this event?
options: event.className
event.detail
questions.explanation: A custom event lets a component tell its surroundings that something happened. Its detail field carries a small value.

questions.question: What should happen to this timer when its element is removed?
options: It should be cleared
It should keep running forever
questions.explanation: disconnectedCallback runs when a custom element leaves the document. Use it to stop repeating work that should no longer run.

questions.question: Which value is used when --note-colour is missing?
options: An empty JavaScript string
green
questions.explanation: The :host selector styles the custom element itself. A CSS custom property can pass a theme choice into a shadow tree.
